message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Three relevant vulnerability groups were verified for the combined, deduplicated primary product scope during the last 24 hours: Microsoft .NET/ASP.NET Core, vLLM, and ImageMagick (listed as `magick`). No new in-window MongoDB ecosystem issue was verified.

**Scope:** `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-24 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-25 23:40 UTC (2026-10-25 05:10 IST through 2026-10-26 05:10 IST).

### Finding 1: Microsoft .NET out-of-band security update

- **Affected product/component:** Microsoft .NET 8, 9, 10 and .NET 11 RC3; ASP.NET Core and `System.IO.Compression` scenarios are relevant for part of the update.
- **Issues:** CVE-2026-114148, CVE-2026-111497, CVE-2026-70197 and CVE-2026-102870.
- **Severity:** High.
- **Description:** Microsoft's October 25 out-of-band release fixes unsafe Linux tarball ownership that can allow local privilege elevation (CVE-2026-114148) and a Brotli decoder buffer overflow that can cause memory disclosure, denial of service or elevation of privilege (CVE-2026-111497). It also re-releases fixes for CVE-2026-70197 and CVE-2026-102870 because the October 13 updates did not fully address them.
- **Why relevant:** The monitored scope explicitly contains Microsoft .NET, ASP.NET Core runtimes/frameworks, and related development tooling.
- **Source:** [Microsoft .NET Blog](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/dotnet/dotnet-october-2026-oob-security-updates/) and [Microsoft .NET 9 servicing notice](https://support.microsoft.com/en-au/servicing/dotnet/net-9/2026/net-9-0-update-october-25-2026).

### Finding 2: Five high-severity vLLM vulnerabilities

- **Affected product/component:** vLLM.
- **Issues:** CVE-2026-116174, CVE-2026-116175, CVE-2026-116176, CVE-2026-116177 and CVE-2026-116178.
- **Severity:** High; reported CVSS scores range from 7.1 to 8.8.
- **Description:** The newly published records cover engine crashes from invalid token IDs, audio and image decompression-bomb denial of service, an SSRF-style outbound connection flaw that can expose NCCL/KV-cache data, and a multimodal-metadata crash. Reported affected ranges vary by issue and begin as early as vLLM 0.9.2; fixed thresholds are reported as 0.24.0, 0.25.0 or 0.30.0 depending on the CVE.
- **Why relevant:** vLLM is explicitly listed in the approved-product source.
- **Sources:** [CVE-2026-116174](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6gg7-pp4x-7486), [CVE-2026-116175](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-116175), [CVE-2026-116176](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3r8v-vh9c-f8hq), [CVE-2026-116177](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p9gm-63qh-x2pq), and [CVE-2026-116178](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-w9hx-wr9v-56wv).

### Finding 3: ImageMagick vulnerability cluster

- **Affected product/component:** ImageMagick / `magick`.
- **Issues:** CVE-2026-116140, CVE-2026-116141, CVE-2026-116142, CVE-2026-116143, CVE-2026-116144, CVE-2026-116145, CVE-2026-116146, CVE-2026-116147, CVE-2026-116148, CVE-2026-116149, CVE-2026-116151, CVE-2026-116153, CVE-2026-116154, CVE-2026-116155, CVE-2026-116156, CVE-2026-116157, CVE-2026-116158, CVE-2026-116159 and CVE-2026-116160.
- **Severity:** One High (CVE-2026-116149, CVSS 7.2); the remaining records are Moderate or Low.
- **Description:** NVD and GitHub published this group on October 25. The issues include a stack-based buffer overflow while decoding bzip2-compressed images, heap over-read/overflow conditions, policy bypasses, injection paths, uncontrolled recursion, null dereference, and several memory leaks. Most records identify ImageMagick 6 before 6.9.13-58 and ImageMagick 7 before 7.1.2-33; some apply only to ImageMagick 7.
- **Why relevant:** The approved-product source lists `magick`, an obvious ImageMagick command/product alias.
- **Sources:** [CVE-2026-116149](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qw5p-x27m-r94r), [GitHub Advisory Database results](https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A2026-10-25+ImageMagick), and [ImageMagick changelog](https://imagemagick.org/changelog/).

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and libraries, MongoDB notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub advisories, and CISA sources.

CVE-2026-115929 for MongoDB Compass was reviewed but excluded because its publication timestamp, 2026-10-24 00:53 UTC, is before the scan cutoff. MongoDB's own current alert list showed its newest bulletin entries on October 22. Sources: [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r9qr-cj53-q38x) and [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for exposed vLLM endpoints and affected .NET/ASP.NET Core deployments because the fresh findings include high-severity remote availability, data-exposure and memory-safety risks. ImageMagick installations that process untrusted files should also be checked promptly against the affected version ranges.
